{{Top|leg}}
The '''hyper-battle stimulant''' was [[Stimulant/Legends|stim]] that essentially blinded the user to all distractions including any damage suffered. This allowed for a greater focus on the battle. The effect would wear off after a short period of time and the side-effects could be considerable.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
